title: CGI Federal announces Momentum® 8.4, expanding automation, AI and built-in compliance capabilities for federal agencies
summary: CGI Federal Inc. (CGI Federal), a leading provider of technology and professional services for the U.S.
body_markdown:
[CGI Federal Inc.](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal) (CGI Federal), a leading provider of technology and professional services for the U.S. government, today announced a new release of its[Momentum Enterprise Suite](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal/momentum-enterprise-suite) . The latest release delivers significant enhancements to the built-for-federal financial, acquisition and budget management system, expanding automation, AI-driven insights and streamlined workflows for federal agencies. Designed to help organizations increase efficiency and respond to evolving regulatory requirements, Momentum 8.4 introduces modern capabilities designed to improve operational performance, ease compliance burden and enhance user experience.


Momentum 8.4 helps federal agencies to unlock deeper insights and optimize their operations with its latest advancements. Through AI-backed conversational analytics offered via Momentum’s analytics agent, agencies can access and interpret data more easily. Additionally, this new release introduces enhancements designed to streamline business processes and maximize utilization of unused funds. Specifically, it features improved capabilities for managing unliquidated obligation (ULO) and unliquidated commitment (ULC) balances, as well as automated recommendations for efficient credit card reconciliation.


This latest release also includes several important updates that support federal compliance. For example, Momentum 8.4 is the first core financial system on the[Treasury Financial Management Quality Service Management Office (FM QSMO) Marketplace](https://tfx.treasury.gov/fmqsmo) to offer commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) integration with GO.gov, the travel management system for federal agencies, enabling integrated processing of travel authorizations, vouchers and advances. It also offers additional regulatory improvements such as new payment justification capabilities and integration with the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Information Returns Intake System (IRIS), allowing agencies to keep pace with the latest federal mandates.


Another major feature of Momentum 8.4 is the introduction of six action-oriented workspaces purpose built for federal workflows, including budget execution, automated match, intra-governmental transaction management, streamlined ordering, credit card statement reconciliation and GO.gov travel management. Each of these workspaces provide guided processes, data insights and centralized tools that improve the speed and quality of work for federal users, helping them complete tasks more intuitively and efficiently. For example, the GO.gov workspace supports financial optimization by simplifying the recovery of unused travel advances through improved visibility and recommended actions.


> “Federal agencies are looking to modernize core operations while navigating evolving requirements and increasing demands for efficiency,” said Kerry Canfield, Vice-President, CGI Federal. “Momentum 8.4 expands automation and compliance capabilities while introducing user-centric enhancements designed to reduce operational complexity across federal supporting functions.”


Momentum 8.4 is available now to all federal agencies. To learn more about how this release can support mission performance and modernize financial, acquisition and budget operations, visit[www.cgi.com/Momentum](https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal/momentum-enterprise-suite) .


## About CGI Federal's Momentum® Enterprise Suite


Momentum is the industry-leading budget, financial and acquisition management software and the first core financial management solution approved by the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Financial Management Quality Service Management Office (FM QSMO). Purpose-built for federal agencies, Momentum leverages agentic AI, intelligent automation, and exception-based processing to empower agencies to achieve new heights of efficiency and compliance with evolving federal priorities. Momentum is CGI Federal's flagship financial management solution and leverages agentic AI, intelligent automation and exception-based processing to empower agencies to achieve new heights of efficiency and compliance with evolving federal priorities.


## About CGI Federal


CGI Federal Inc. is a leading U.S.-based technology and professional services company that serves federal agencies across defense, civilian, healthcare, justice, intelligence and international affairs. With nearly 8,000 professionals, CGI Federal works with its clients to modernize government through innovative technology solutions, flexible delivery models and a commitment to achieve mission outcomes. CGI Federal is a wholly-owned subsidiary of CGI Inc. For more information, visit www.cgifederal.com.
